name: minimind
description: 🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
one_liner: A step-by-step kit that lets anyone train their own small AI language model from scratch in a couple of hours, mostly to learn how the technology actually works.
buyer: A university instructor or self-taught engineer who wants a hands-on way to learn how large language models are built, not a business buying a product.
business_use_cases: An online education company builds a paid 'build your own LLM in a weekend' course using it as the lab exercise.
A company training new ML hires uses it as an onboarding exercise to build intuition before they touch production models.
A YouTuber or newsletter writer uses it as the hands-on centerpiece of a tutorial series to build an audience, then monetizes the audience separately.

money_ideas.idea: Turn it into a paid cohort-based course on 'how LLMs really work' with live office hours.
Sell a polished, better-documented companion guidebook for teams onboarding new ML engineers.

steal_this: This is an educational project, not a commercial opportunity on its own — honestly, the only fast weekend project is a short paid tutorial walking non-experts through running it once.
